messages:
alex kim: Heads-up — need 2x LGTM on PR #9432 to ship the quantization hotfix before the 18:00 PT cutoff (~40m). It touches kernel selection and the runtime memguard. @maria gonzalez @samir patel can you take a look?

maria gonzalez: looking now, kicking off smoke tests on canary

deploy-bot: canary deployment canary-9432 started (canary id: canary-2026-03-18-17-18)

samir patel: quick scan — left one small nit around a null-check in compile_state.rs, not a blocker. overall changes look safe.

lee chen: I can give a +1 after smoke. also request a post-deploy kv-cache warm job (we saw cold-path flakiness last week).

alex kim: noted — I'll add the kv-warm job to the post-deploy hook. runbook: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/kv-warm (small)

maria gonzalez: smoke passed on canary: no perf regression, latency p50/p95 within expected. snippet: `baseline p95=120ms -> canary p95=125ms (1.04x)`

samir patel: re-reviewing the nit now, will push a one-line fix if needed, otherwise LGTM

samir patel: pushed a tiny guard change and re-requested review. Marking LGTM :thumbsup:

lee chen: verified the guard, LGTM from me too. :white_check_mark:

alex kim: ok merging in ~5m. @oncall-sre please standby for rollback window (10m after cutover).

oncall-sre: standing by. rollback playbook open and fast-path tested.

deploy-bot: PR #9432 merged by alex kim into release/hotfix-2026-03-18

alex kim: starting cutover now (rolling across regions). will trigger kv-warm post-deploy when each region completes.

maria gonzalez: post-deploy smoke green in us-west-2, kv-warm job kicked: `./scripts/kv_warm --region us-west-2 --workers 8`

samir patel: monitoring runtime mem and kv hit-rate. nothing alarming in first 10m.

lee chen: cool — follow-up: i'll open a tiny PR adding the new null-check test to prevent regressions.

alex kim: thanks everyone. tagging release notes and closing out this thread once post-deploy is stable. :v:
